Platform: tiktok

Creator: @chef_wills_

Caption / description / post text:
Cancel your dinner plans with this charcuterie dipping oil!  Salty. Herby. A little bit boujee. This isn’t just dipping oil — it’s a charcuterie board in disguise.  Ingredients: EVOO  Balsamic Vinegar  Olives 🫒  Gherkins 🥒  Cheese 🧀  Salami 🍖  Basil 🌿  Parsley 🌿  #bread #oliveoil #charcuterie #dippingsauce #foodtok 

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
There's one thing I've learned from doing these videos is that the internet goes crazy for a bread dipping oil and usually the most decadent ones tend to be the best received. So it's a long overdue sequel to my most successful ever video. Today I present to you a Chuck-Cuttery style dip, where as you can see I've chucked together a whole host of ingredients into what feels like a bathtub's worth of olive oil and balsamic vinegar. You'll see multiple different types of salami, olives, cheeses, you name it. I'm not going to teach you how to eat it but I have no doubt you'll do a fantastic job.
